items.name: Cross-Platform Data Integration
items.description: Delivered deduplication for 10,000+ donor records across four disconnected platforms, with a staff review workflow for uncertain matches.
items.problem: Nonprofit staff tracked donor data across Zeffy, RunSignUp, JotForm, and Bloomerang, leaving 10,000+ records fragmented across four data structures with duplicates that could not always be resolved automatically.
responsibilities: Gathered requirements from nonprofit staff and scoped a unified CRM view across four disconnected platforms
Built Python and NumPy cleaning and deduplication workflows for 10,000+ records
Created a review dashboard that let staff approve uncertain record matches instead of relying on blind automation
Compared an in-house build with third-party CRM connectors on cost, data ownership, and delivery timeline, then presented the tradeoffs
items.impact: Delivered a human-in-the-loop deduplication workflow for 10,000+ records and gave the team evidence to choose an implementation path across four data sources.

items.name: TileTalk — Phonics Learning App
items.description: Turned ~20 requests from a 2nd-grade teacher into 7 core features, then coordinated delivery of 16 features by the May deadline.
items.problem: A 2nd-grade teacher needed a digital phonics tool, but roughly 20 competing requests, a multi-disciplinary team, and a $0 operating budget made scope and infrastructure choices critical.
responsibilities: Synthesized ~20 classroom requests into 7 core features and a phased product roadmap
Evaluated backend and authentication options and moved login and data from Clever to Supabase to maintain a $0 operating cost
Led biweekly reviews and Jira delivery across the client, a UI designer, and a 6-person engineering team
items.impact: Shipped 16 features, including all 7 core features, by the May deadline while keeping the product at $0 operating cost.

items.name: FrontFoot
items.description: AI-powered scheduling assistant that turns constraints into a ready-made schedule using Google Calendar and Gemini.
items.problem: Manually building a schedule around existing commitments and personal constraints is slow and easy to get wrong.
responsibilities: Developed an AI-powered scheduling assistant integrating the Google Calendar API and Gemini API
Designed automation workflows to generate schedules based on user input and constraints
Implemented API-based system architecture for real-time task management and calendar sync
items.impact: Automated schedule generation and real-time calendar sync, removing manual back-and-forth scheduling.

items.name: ATE!
items.description: Built a nutrition tracking product backed by 7,327 USDA foods across 24 categories and roughly 140,000 nutrient values.
items.problem: Food search, meal logging, and personalized nutrition insights required a reliable data foundation, relevant search results, and APIs that could support multiple user workflows.
responsibilities: Built an ETL pipeline that loaded USDA FoodData Central into a searchable database of 7,327 foods, 24 categories, and ~140,000 nutrient values
Filtered chain-restaurant entries to improve search relevance and structured the data for product use
Designed REST APIs for food search, meal logging, weekly analysis, and personalized suggestions
items.impact: Converted a large public nutrition dataset into a product-ready search and analytics foundation supporting 7,327 foods and four core user workflows.

items.name: MUSEEK
items.description: Competitive analysis and product definition for a mentorship-driven collaboration platform for independent musicians.
items.problem: Independent and student musicians had no affordable, mentorship-driven alternative to existing gig-marketplace platforms like Fiverr, Sonicbids, and SoundBetter.
responsibilities: Led competitive analysis (Fiverr, Sonicbids, SoundBetter), surfacing a market gap in affordable, mentorship-driven collaboration tools
Synthesized user research on independent/student musicians into product OKRs
Defined core features: discovery algorithm, analytics dashboard, messaging
items.impact: Turned market research into a scoped, validated feature set aligned to an identified market gap.

items.name: E-Commerce Growth Analytics
items.description: Analyzed ~500 monthly e-commerce users and built automated KPI dashboards to identify retention trends and growth opportunities.
items.problem: Leadership lacked real-time visibility into session activity, repeat purchase rate, and retention trends needed to evaluate the company's next growth opportunity.
responsibilities: Analyzed behavior from ~500 monthly users in Python to surface retention patterns
Built automated KPI dashboards tracking session activity and repeat purchase rate
Translated the findings into a recommendation to expand from online retail into accommodation
items.impact: Gave leadership real-time performance visibility and an evidence-backed recommendation to expand into halal-focused accommodation.
